edges.reason: initialize requires msg.sender == factory, so the caller identity gates token0/token1 assignment
setFeeTo requires msg.sender == feeToSetter to change the protocol fee recipient
setFeeToSetter requires msg.sender == feeToSetter to transfer admin rights
transferFrom reads allowance[from][msg.sender] and uses msg.sender as spender
approve passes msg.sender as the allowance owner
transfer moves funds from msg.sender
permit compares the deadline parameter with block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency
_update derives blockTimestamp from block.timestamp for the TWAP accumulators
_mintFee reads factory.feeTo to decide whether protocol fees are on
_mintFee calls IUniswapV2Factory(factory).feeTo()
initialize is protected by the stored factory address being msg.sender
setFeeTo authorization depends on the feeToSetter state variable
setFeeToSetter authorization depends on the feeToSetter state variable
swap optimistically transfers tokens and calls IUniswapV2Callee(to).uniswapV2Call before balance checks and _update, enabling reentrancy/flash-loan callbacks
_safeTransfer performs an arbitrary external token.call, which is the reentrancy vector reachable from swap, burn and skim
swap performs output token transfers through _safeTransfer
burn sends the underlying tokens out through _safeTransfer
skim transfers excess balances through _safeTransfer
transferFrom delegates the balance update to _transfer
transfer delegates the balance update to _transfer
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve
permit calls _approve after signature verification
permit recovers the signer via ecrecover and compares it to owner
mint calls _mintFee before computing liquidity
mint calls _mint to create LP tokens (including MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY)
mint calls _update with new balances and reserves
burn calls _burn on the pair's own LP balance
burn calls _mintFee before pro-rata payout computation
burn re-reads balances and calls _update
swap calls _update after the K invariant check
sync passes current balances and reserves to _update
_update adds the encoded price ratio times timeElapsed into price0CumulativeLast (overflow is desired)
_update adds the encoded price ratio times timeElapsed into price1CumulativeLast (overflow is desired)
_update stores the current blockTimestamp into blockTimestampLast
_mint increases totalSupply using SafeMath add
_burn decreases totalSupply using SafeMath sub
_burn decreases the sender balance using SafeMath sub
_approve writes the allowance mapping
_transfer adjusts both balances with SafeMath sub/add
transferFrom decrements the allowance with SafeMath sub when not infinite
createPair deploys the pair contract via inline assembly create2
createPair writes both directions of the getPair mapping
createPair pushes the new pair into allPairs
initialize assigns token0
initialize assigns token1
getReserves returns reserve0
getReserves returns reserve1
getReserves returns blockTimestampLast
_mint relies on the SafeMath add bound when updating totalSupply/balanceOf
_burn and _transfer rely on the SafeMath sub bound for balanceOf updates
_update performs UQ112x112 encode/uqdiv multiplications and accumulator additions whose overflow is intentionally tolerated
the deadline parameter controls the permit expiry require against block.timestamp
swap routes output tokens to the to parameter and checks to != token0/token1
amount0Out is subtracted from reserve0 and used in the K invariant arithmetic
amount1Out is subtracted from reserve1 and used in the K invariant arithmetic
timeElapsed drives the price accumulator multiplication where underflow/overflow is desired
liquidity is computed with mul/div and sqrt in mint before being minted
amount0In feeds the balance0Adjusted computation and the final K require

normalization_plan.reason: deadline is only a permit parameter that is folded into the permit access-control/timestamp check and carries no independent identity
the to parameter only influences the swap output transfer target and event emission, so it collapses into swap
amount0Out is a swap-local numeric parameter used solely in swap arithmetic and transfer logic
amount1Out is a swap-local numeric parameter used solely in swap arithmetic and transfer logic
timeElapsed is a temporary local inside _update whose value is fully determined by _update inputs
liquidity is a temporary local in mint representing the LP amount minted, subsumed by the mint function node
amount0In is a swap-local derived value used only for the K invariant check inside swap
